support_wrapper.collection_framing_upper: 40 plus actual node count bytes per operation; conservatively includes optional module_evidence field, array/braces and commas
support_wrapper.uniqueness: evidence_reference is unique across all retained module wrappers. Every module-node alias resolves exactly one wrapper, across kinds. Existing payload definitions remain exact; no node address is inferred from list order.
support_wrapper.placement: SupportingEvidence.module_evidence is an optional additive array emitted only when nonempty. Each member is an exact closed SafeModuleEvidence; kind selects exact owned payload class. No changes to legacy serialized empty shape.
support_wrapper.export: Protected commit_supporting writes full wrapper bytes. Snapshot JSON and Markdown render the same actual wrapper nodes; no implied node address reconstructed from order.
